nom: TATCHA The Longevity Serum Skin Strength & Resilience Treatment

avis.texte: I live all Tacha products but this one dried our my skin horribly
Absorbs well into skin. Smooth feeling. i am enjoying the resuts
I just started putting the serums into my skincare and I love the results I'm seeing after using it for a while.
I like the serum, but haven't found it to be superior to any other "longevity" serums that I have tried. Not certain it is worth the price.
I use this in combination with the dewy skin moisturizer and it has made my skin feel like a dream! So soft!

This Longevity Serum has become my new favorite serum. I like that it doesn't take a lot and the smell is pleasant. I look forward to my nightly routine of using this and the Longevity cream. Tatcha has done it again!

I received this for the first time as a sample in my monthly Ipsy subscription. I was obsessed the first time I used it. I immediately came to the website to buy the full sized bottle!! 10/10 highly recommend and worth the money!
This serum is a must have in my collection of Tatcha products. I love bothe serum and cream . Both longevity products works extremely well separate or together .
I love the new longevity line. The serum is smooth and the lotion is thick and I have seen an improvement in skin elasticity and smoothness

I love this product so much. I didn't think I really needed it because I alternate between two other Tatcha serums, and the Dewey moisturizer leaves my skin glowing. However, adding this not only feels great it makes my skin glowing even more. I describe it as glowing, but don't confuse that with oily or greasy because that's not the texture or look you'll have after using this. I want a larger size of this serum.

I love this so much. It makes my skin looks so radiant. Gives me a confident glow. I just want to keep smearing it on. I received a sample of this from Ipsy which bought me to the site. I'm not impressed with the cost but I suppose a little goes a long way. The smell is pleasant and it has a nice consistency. Looking forward to being able to fit the full-sized option into my beauty budget.
I incorporated this into my skincare routine but I don't use it everyday
The serum makes my skin glow and I can definitely tell a difference with my skin after using this product for two weeks
I absolutely love all my products from Tatcha so the Longevity serum was no different! Loving how it absorbs into my skin

It transforms my skin instantly and gives it a glowy finish and creates a base for moisturizer and enhances the look of my foundation. Sometimes I wear it with moisturizer and I don't need a foundation. It's definitely better than other pricey brands I have used. I am not yet sure if will have a long lasting impact on reducing wrinkles but as long as I use it skin looks supple and healthy.
I used this serum daily and since the first use I knew it was a great product. Gentle to skin but you know it's doing the job.

Liked this serum. Goes on smooth and my skin feels soft. Want to try the longevity cream. Received a sample to try and to be honest there was hardly any cream in the packet. I could not really tell if I would purchase because there wasn't enough cream to make a decision. I do appreciate the free samples however they are getting smaller. 4 stars due to the price of the product
Very drying . This is unlike the other products . I don't see or feel any benefit from using this product . Do not recommend

I love all of Tatcha products but this one has a very unfamiliar texture and seems to be drying for my skin. I don't think I will reorder this again or recommend to others in my age. The Dewey cream is much better and I will wait until funds allow for me to substitute back to my go to cream. In the interim, I gifted both serum and cream to my neighbor with different skin type in hopes they will fall in love with Tatcha… staying pessimistic and optimistic in same breath.

I had high hopes for this brand but it just is too expensive for the amount you get. I also think other brands work better on my skin. I am glad I tried Tacha, but I don't think I'd repeat my purchase.
I love the way this feels so luxurious on my skin. The packaging is beautiful and great quality. And the scent really smells like a spa.
I don't feel I can fairly review this serum yet. I had previously been using the Silk Serum. Love my Tatcha products!
I use this serum at night with Longevity cream. Skin feels fresher and brighter.

I bought a small bottle and I've been using it a couple weeks now. My skin is starting to look more hydrated and sometimes of my laugh lines around my mouth are starting to look less visible. I'm very pleased with the product so far far.

I bought the Longevity Serum when it was first released. At first, I was a little bit skeptical because I didn't know if it was the same thing as all the anti aging serums I see in ads and in person. However, after doing tons of research and trying it out for myself, I am in love! I will never live without this product again!
Do not like the odor. Will return to other tatcha formulas that I love.
I've been using the serum for about 1 month and have definitely noticed my wrinkles around my eyes are less noticeable.
Love the feel and scent of this serum. Not too heavy and not too light.

I cannot say enough good things about this amazing product, and the entire Longevity Line from Tatcha. I am recommending it to all my friends and family as it is a complete game changer for skin care. Thank you so much to all the amazing people at Tacha.

I absolutely love ir! I haven't ordered a full size yet only because of the price, but I would like to. I have recommended it to some friends as well. I am a QVC watcher and was looking for it to be on yesterday during Tatcha's hour, but it wasn't.
Formula feels great when applying and after it dries. Seen a difference in my skin overall and less wrinkles on my forehead.
not a bad product. I'm still waiting to see a significant change in skin texture.

Honestly was not very impressed with this product. I had expectations after reading reviews. I didn't notice a difference and the bottle did not last. I opened both the longevity and silk serum at the same time and longevity one ran out way before the silk one. I use the silk serum and like the results better

avis.titre: Made my skin feel tight and dry
avis.texte: Serum smells pleasant and makes my skin look good. However, my face feels so tight, dry, and is uncomfortable after use. Following up with moisturizer helps slightly. I stopped using the serum for a few days and my skin felt better. Will not purchase again

Pleasantly surprised with this new serum as many anti-aging products have been irritating my skin including vitamin C. I have had no reactions and don't mind the scent. I prefer to smell the product than something overly fragranced. I'm looking forward to the benefits and ordering the cream.
OH love this serum. It gives me the glow that I had been looking for.
I use it at night and it burns my skin so bad I have to wash it off.
Haven't used it long enough to tell a difference yet, but it feels luxurious on my skin.
I've been using it a couple weeks. Don't really see any difference.
To me the serum showed no benefit and plan to return. Other Tatcha products are excellent for my skin but no this one
It feels great on the skin, I just don't like that theirs double walled and your getting very little product for that price point.
I love Tatcha! But this formulation is my least favorite. The smell is not pleasant and it contains Turpentine.
I love the way it goes onto my skin. It's smooth and doesn't feel greasy at all. I plan on ordering a large container.

I am not sure about this one, I purchased all my products accept for the small ones they gave free for purchasing over $150 worth of products. I am 100% unbiased and I have to say I have seen a good difference in my skin , but the smell is very overwhelming. This is probably not in control of tatcha since some plants have that smell. As soon as you use any of their serums or creams you know immediately they use natural products. I am intrigued with their products and I plan on purchasing more, my 23 year old daughter introduced me to them when she was 16, and I thought they were just for teens and young adults but I was wrong. What ever your age, pay for a trial size and see if you can tell a difference. This is how you will know. Shiseido was all that ever worked for me but it has become too expensive and it causes me red patches on my face and body. Never did this prior to 2022 but I still used it. Tatcha is better in many ways just make sure you get what is tailored to your skin type. I have had minor break outs with some of the products.
This product is working well so far. My skin appears more blemish free and smooth. It smells wonderful!
Love the way it makes my skin feel. Product definitely does what it says its intended for.
This is an outstanding product. It evens and brightens my skin, and ameliorates the fine lines in my neck area.
I love the consistency and the smell. Both extremely important to me. I haven't seen any noticeable difference although it's only been a couple of weeks.
I love the smell makes me want to use it every day I Waite to use it I love it

I can't believe how my skin feels and looks. I have tried thousands of brands and by far TATCHA is the best! I saw results within 2weeks of consistently using their products. I followed the recommended rituals for what I was targeting which was pore refining, brightening dark spots under eyes and firmness. I'm 50 years old and have dry skin. I'm beyond satisfied.
My skin is very sensitive. This serum turned me very red in about 30 minutes and made it feel on fire. So I had to wash it off.
I tried this serum and after one week I noticed a difference in the lines around my mouth area. I recommend you try it, you will not be disappointed.
Helps my skin feels tighter and perkier. I use this for AM and the retinol-alternative as a PM serum.
I just started using this product. I l. ove it. I ordered more plus more of your products. Thank You!
This serum has stopped my need for liquid foundation in just 2 weeks. I'm only using powder as my base now, and my skin is so much smoother and softer:
After just 3 weeks of use my skin is glowing, softer and fewer fine lines. At 65 my skin is looking 20 yrs younger.
I use it in the morning. It feels good so far. But it's too early to determine efficacy as I have only used it for a week.
Makes my skin feel so nourished and healthy it absorbs so well into the skin! My skin is glowing!
The Tatcha Serum is amazing. I will be ordering more very soon
This serum has been a game changer, definitely has made my complexion smoother and softer. Highly recommend. I truly love Tatcha products.

I initially tried the sample to see how my rosacea skin would react. It was safe my rosacea skin and it was nice and plumping. It feels healthy for my skin. I enjoy this serum, I don't know if i notice major changes in anti-aging, but it is a nice serum. I'm not sure if I would necessarily repurchase, it is a nice to have, not a necessary.
I've had so many people comment that my skin glows after I've started using this. Especially on conference calls! It's so great on the skin too! No oily texture. This is definitely my go to serum now

I added the Longevity Serum to my Tatcha reigning, and it is has truly changed my skin. I use the rice cleanser, essence, then I add the serum. My skin looks fresh and plump. I can't believe how much better my skin looks. The wrinkles I have are so much less pronounced, I am thrilled!! I am on auto ship, so glad because I will never be without!

I just turned 70 and have combo to dry skin. The serum works well, makes my skin very moisturized, and works well with my other facial products. I can feel and see a difference. I have sinus allergies and can't take strong fragrances. The serum has a light fresh scent, doesn't aggravate my sinuses. Well worth the purchase.
The serum has an amazing smell. It is not tacky or makes your face feel different after use.
I have tried a lot of top quality serums. After using Tatcha products my complexion is the best it has ever been. I use less makeup and my skin appears to be healthier.

i bought this because i love Tatcha products i have bought before. But this, I love this Longevity serum. It really makes my skin smooth and softens my face. I don't know what it is doing, but my skin feels amazingly soft, my color tone is more even and it makes me look more youthful somehow. I love this.
Love how it makes my skin feel. Just started using so I don't have much to say yet.
I like this serum because it is very lightweight yet leaves my skin smooth. I live in the tropics so I can't bear anything goopy on my face so this serum works well for me.
This serum has a nice texture and goes on smoothly. Too soon to tell a noticeable difference, but my skin looks good.

I'm going to be :100:with everyone. I needed a less expensive serum from the one I usually have been using when I saw this. I have extremely sensitive skin, so I still wanted to at least try it. I'm 55 and to my surprise, this is an absolutely beautiful serum!! It goes on so beautifully. Just melts right in. All day moisture. I don't even need my facial cream after. Goes very well under makeup. Smells beautiful. Makes my skin glow. I'll definitely be reordering!! Nice work on this!!
Fantastic addition to my skincare. Makes my skin feel clean and soft.
This is an amazing serum. My skin looks healthy, plump and soft after applying it. Smells good. I could see changes in my skin after using it for about 2 weeks.
I love this serum. I use it with my sun screen, my skin is soft and glowing after I apply it.
I have only been using the longevity serum for about 2 or 3 weeks. I really like how it feels on my face when I apply it. The color of the bottle is very nice.
I used it on freshly derma-planed skin. Soothing and very comfortable on the skin. Followed with Water Cream and SPF, my skin feels protected and healthy!
Very heavy; doesn't absorb into skin afcter being on all night.

This is my favorite serum. I love the quick results! This serum, along with my return to daily use of the Rice Polish has improved my skin so much in just a couple of weeks. Many people tell me how great my skin looks, and I tell them about Tatcha.

Love this. It is perfect for older senior skin. My face feels plump and moist all day. I'm 76 and yes I have wrinkles. Lots of them. And at my age it takes surgery to get rid of them But this makes my skin look and feel younger and healthier.
This serum is fantastic! A little goes a long way and makes my skin soft and supple!
I'm pleasantly surprised that I saw immediate improvements to my skin. My Tatcha products never disappoint!
Smells like citrus. Feels smooth. Does not irritate my sensitive skin.
Wonderful stuff! Melts right into my skin and leaves my skin soft and smooth.
I love this product, it makes my skin feel so smooth. It pairs great with the Silk cream.
I can see a slight difference in the texture of my skin. It seems to be clearer. I do like the way the product melts into my sking.

This stuff really works! This stuff really works! I have really bad dark marks from my breakouts, and in the last 3 weeks I've been using this, they've gotten so much lighter. My skin feels so smooth and hydrated and healthy. Gifted by tatcha
It absorbs into your skin immediately and keeps it hydrated all day long. No need to reapply. Love how my skin feels when I put it on as a base layer.

I've been testing out the new Tatcha Longevity Serum for a little while now, and I can honestly say it feels like skincare luxury in a bottle. The texture is super lightweight almost like water when it first goes on but it still manages to leave my skin feeling hydrated and plump without any greasiness. I also love that it layers seamlessly with the rest of my routine (especially under moisturizer and SPF), so it doesn't cause any pilling. After consistent use, I've noticed my skin looking a bit smoother and more refreshed, almost like it's brighter from within. The formula feels gentle, which is a big win for my sensitive skin, and I haven't experienced any irritation or breakouts. Packaging wise, it's beautiful as always with Tatcha, it really makes the whole experience feel special. It's definitely a splurge, but if you're looking for a serum that blends hydration, smoothness, and that spa like Tatcha feel, this one is worth checking out. Gifted by tatcha

I received this item complimentary from Tacha in exchange for my honest review. This serum is very hydrating. It absorbed very well into my skin. It didnt leave any weird textures or residue. Just radiant moisturized skin. I feel it really helped my texture and breakouts. It did have a bit of a weird scent but it went away quickly.
I like the way it leaves my skin feeling, very smooth and silky.
I love it. Even though I did not use it regularly my friends commented on my skin saying that it radiates. I use it and then I put moisturizer. Very happy.

The Tatcha longevity serum has become a product that I have grown to love. Initially, the scent of this product threw me off, but overtime, I have seen so much improvement in the appearance and feeling of my skin. My skin retains a gorgeous glow after using it, several hours after application, and my skin is visibly smooth. Highly recommended! I received this product complimentary from tatcha.

I love this serum! it leaves my skin feeling so hydrated and glowy. after multiple uses so far, I can tell it has smoothed my fine lines. I also love how the smell isn't overpowering because I like my skincare to be mostly unscented. Complimentary from tatcha.
